description: Type the 409 DELETE /v1/organizations/{organizationId}/services/{serviceId} answers for a service in a state that cannot be terminated, after the deletion protection check passes: {"status": 409, "error": "CONFLICT: Only instance in one of the following states: 'provisioning','starting','awaking','idle','stopped','degraded','failed' can be terminated. Current state: 'running'"}. The spec types it only as the shared envelope, so it surfaced as the generic Conflict, which deletion protection and every other conflict also answer. Observed live 2026-11-12 deleting a running service without deletion protection (request id 81eac1eb-e19e-4469-aba7-ed5f68ed29b6); the same call on a stopped service answered 200.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: The service is in a state that cannot be deleted (running or stopping). Stop it, wait for it to be stopped, and delete it again.
